verdict.issue: Sentence 2 incorrectly says the new power permits moving categories; the text permits moving only a code or type of AI system from one category to another.
Sentence 2 is unfaithful because the pipeline header establishes that paragraph 2 differs, so it cannot be described as textually unchanged.

Sentence 1 incorrectly says Section 10.4.1(b) no longer refers to endocrine-disrupting substances identified through Article 59 of Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, even though the after text retains that reference.
